title: Canadian War Museum
scope: Standing Canadian War Museum on Vimy Place in Ottawa, including its walkable grass roofs, low exposed concrete, angled eastern curtain wall, pedestrian terrace and copper-clad Regeneration Hall fin.
limitations: The 24.5 m peak is documented. Roof slopes use measured first-return samples, with localized interpretation at steps, narrow windows and parapets below the lidar resolution.
Curtain-wall subdivisions, concrete seams, copper panel widths and Morse aperture positions are approximated. The bilingual words encoded on the north fin are documented.

The exterior represents the standing museum with finished grass roofs and public terrace. The archive photo was taken during construction. Site hoardings, unfinished roof surfaces and current exhibition objects are outside the modeled scope.
